title: Elixir of Vigilance

sources.title: Elixir of Vigilance
markers: * Drink to gain a +5 bonus to Initiative. In addition, you can't be Surprised. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.

sources.title: Elixirs
markers: Only one elixir can be applied at a time

summary: Drink as a Bonus Action. Gain +5 Initiative and immunity to Surprised until the next Long Rest.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Gain +5 Initiative and immunity to Surprised until the next Long Rest.
fields.Stacking: Replaces another elixir effect. Drinking a different elixir can end this effect early.
fields.Creative use: Drink before a fight where this effect will matter.
fields.Crafting: Combine Sublimate of Bloodstained Hook with any Ashes.
fields.Base value: 25 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 activation, effects and linked rules.
